title: Hook fps flex btw
features:
If you don't like it, just ignore instead of looking like Baptists giving unlike
Hooked fps, mem, resolution, quality.
mem is Memory, res is Resolution
script:
local old
old = hookmetamethod(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").nya, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
    local args = {...}
    if getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" and args[1] and args[1]["token"] then
        args[1]["fps"] = args[1]["fps"] + math.random(-5, 5)
        args[1]["mem"] = args[1]["mem"] * 100
        args[1]["gfx"] = Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel10
        args[1]["res"] = Vector2.new(50000, 50000)
        args[1]["t"] = args[1]["t"]
    end
    return old(self, unpack(args))
end
